fact: The INS South regional agency published the 2023 edition (sixth edition) of the Annuaire statistique de la Région Sud on 2 August 2024, compiling the statistics of sectoral administrations in the region (education, health, justice, security, trade, transport, public finance).
title: ANNUAIRE STATISTIQUE DE LA REGION SUD, EDITION 2023
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique du Cameroun
